note: Rejudged 2026-10-30 (independent auditor) after the row gained a {partial} scope. RFC 2131 Section 4.1: "The options in the 'options' field MUST be interpreted first, so that any 'option overload' options may be interpreted." Tested: The options in the 'options' field MUST be interpreted first. Server: findOption walks the options field before file and sname; TestOverloadInterpretationOrder (positive, options copy wins under 52=3), TestOverloadFieldsCarryOptions (positive, 52 honoured) and the negative (a 52 inside file opens no sname) discriminate it, with revert records on every cover and the earlier overlay mutants. Client: FromBytes reads only the options field for options, so the order clause holds there too. Gap: so that any 'option overload' options may be interpreted. Producer internal/plugins/iface/dhcp/dhcp_v4_exchange_linux.go::acquire passes each reply to vendored nclient4, whose dhcpv4 FromBytes reads sname and file as strings and never consults option 52 (no build-time patch), so the client loses options a server places in an overloaded field.
